model_definitions.scope: Woody annual prototype algorithms; none are fitted physiological laws.
model_definitions.extension_noise: Independent keyed annual multiplier in [0.75,1.25), separate from the inherited leader potential.
model_definitions.light_field: Exponential screening by vertical crown depth; competition augments a0.2 baseline. Not ray-traced light or a measured canopy field.
model_definitions.nodal_azimuth: Equal azimuth slots with keyed jitter up to15% of slot width, rotated by yearly phase. A sampling choice, not measured bud phyllotaxis.
model_definitions.internodal_positions: Sample in the interior from0.1 to0.8 minus the nodal span fraction; upward component0.05 is an orientation choice.
model_definitions.daughter_attachments: Sample from30% to90% of the new parent shoot. Daughter trials independent within this hypothesis.
model_definitions.curvature: Age-dependent terminal-direction sag saturates at12 years, opposed by tip bias. No retrospective mechanics.
model_definitions.needle_survival: Whole cohort retained for a fixed integer lifetime, then shed. A cohort-age count distribution is not a survival curve.
model_definitions.radial_growth: Available radial volume scales positive foliage-pipe area deficits proportionally; accumulated wood never shrinks. Pipe shortfall remains explicit stress, not a validated support constraint.
model_definitions.roots: Resource accounting compartment only; no root architecture, uptake or soil coupling.
model_definitions.growth_time: One tick per synthetic year, no within-season phenology. Each shoot keeps birth geometry. Radii and living state change explicitly.
model_definitions.foliage_resource: New cohort birth counts debit an explicit wood-volume-equivalent cost. This is a coarse resource currency, not physical carbon or photosynthesis.

execution_limits.note: Operational refusal limit, not an inherited botanical trait.
